feature: Ask runs inside Photonz, with no Ollama or any other program to open
summary: Ask's chat model and the picture model it paints with both run inside Photonz now. Settings > Ask downloads each once, showing its size and where it goes, and Photonz starts them when Ask needs them and lets them go when idle or on quit. Nothing else needs installing, opening or keeping running, and once set up Ask works with no network. On the held-out set it scores 61 against 60.3 for the Ollama setup it replaces.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default, Ollama not running. M4 Max, 64 GB. For the first-run steps nothing may be downloaded yet (ask-sets-itself-up-walk gives the probe that Mac).

try.do: Before: with Ollama closed, the old build stopped with "Ask needs Ollama. See Settings." and offered no fix inside Photonz.
On a Mac with nothing downloaded, press Ask on a screenshot, send a request, then click Open Settings under Ask's sentence.
In Settings > Ask, click Download for the chat model, then Download Z-Image Turbo below it. Each one shows its size and where it goes first.
Watch the picture model's bar: the weights come down, then "Setting up Z-Image Turbo" while Photonz builds its own tools. Stop is beside it the whole time.
When both are done, Settings > Ask shows Model and Pictures rows instead of the offers.
Turn Wi-Fi off. On a screenshot, ask "annotate the ux with measurements around the major ui elements".
try.shotNote: Taken with the probe cut off from the network by the walk's setup, not with Wi-Fi off; the window was behind another app, so picked controls show their background look.

try.do: Still offline, on a blank canvas ask "draw a red bicycle" and wait about half a minute.
try.shotNote: Taken with the probe cut off from the network by the walk's setup; the window was behind another app.

try.do: Quit Photonz and look in Activity Monitor: no llama-server and no python is left.

evaluate: Is a second Download for pictures (11.2 GB) right, or should one Download fetch both models?
Does a first drawing after a while (the picture model loads in a few seconds, then about 30 s to paint) feel acceptable?
Is "Ask can paint its drawings with Z-Image Turbo, 11.2 GB. It goes in Application Support > Photonz > Models." clear about what you get?
Should "Use Ollama instead" stay in Settings, or go?
rough: Runtimes: chat is llama.cpp's llama-server b11826 in Contents/Helpers/AskModel with Qwen3.6 35B-A3B (21.0 GB download, 21.7 GB held, 8 to 13 s to load). Pictures are Z-Image Turbo 8-bit run by mflux in a private Python 3.12.11 that Photonz builds with the uv it ships (Contents/Helpers/PictureModel/uv). That is 11.0 GB of weights plus 435 MB of tools, about 12 s to install them from cold, about 2 s to load from a warm disk, 26 to 30 s a drawing, 11.2 GB resident and about 25 GB at its peak while painting.
Chose an environment Photonz builds itself over porting mflux and the tracer to Swift: it reuses the measured pipeline unchanged. A native port would be a much larger job for no gain in score.

Held-out set, Next defaults, no Ollama: 61 over 45 cases (drawing 69.1, layout 6.4, redline 31.5, video 48.1; 41.5 s median), run 20261022-231423-ask-held-out, against 60.3 before. Measured before the add_title wording change below.

Climb set: built in 55.3 against Ollama's 53.1 (runs 20261022-204744-ask and 20261022-212621-ask, no picture model). The video gap (39.5 against 52.1) was one case where the model left the first title unplaced every time (17.5, 17.5, 17.8). After add_title said where an unplaced page goes, that case scored 84.4 and the video group 53.1 (run 20261023-011305-ask).

The three named requests, built in against Ollama: screenshot measurements 46.6 against 47.4, Case 1 title page 84.4 against 79.6, pricing on brand 19 against 11.2. Offline, send to done: 9.5 s, 10.2 s and 59.3 s.
Offline was proven by cutting the probe and every helper it starts off from everything but this Mac (a walk setup, "offline"), not by turning Wi-Fi off; setup checks that a fetch from the web fails.
Both model servers let go 5 min 12 s after Ask last used them, with Photonz still open; after quit, nothing of Photonz's was running one second later (process list).

The picture model is offered only on a Mac that can hold it beside the chat model (12 GB on top of the chat model, within three fifths of memory), so a 48 GB Mac is not offered it and Ask draws its own SVG there.

The Ask eval can score 0 on the case that starts on three clips when it is the first case of a run, because its bridge launches the app before the walk does: filed as an-eval-case-that-starts-on-three-clips-runs-whe.
The Settings window opens short, and the sticky "Questions you have silenced" header covers the top of the Ask section until you scroll.
No mock covers Settings > Ask or Ask's setup sentence.
